name: unify-vscode-companion
description: Send explicitly approved VS Code editor context and diagnostics to the local UNIFY desktop app.

commands.title: UNIFY: Send Current File to Desktop Assistant

unify.monitoring.enabled.description: Allow this extension to send editor context to the local UNIFY desktop app.

unify.monitoring.allowedWorkspacePaths.description: Exact workspace folder paths approved for monitoring. Empty means no workspace is approved.

unify.monitoring.sendOnDocumentChange.description: Send updated context when the active file changes and has diagnostics.
